{
  outputs = { self }:
    let
      bin =
        pkgs: name:
        pkgs.runCommand name { } ''
          cp -r ${src}/bend src
          bend src/${name} -o $out/bin/${name}
        '';
    in {
      deploy = pkgs.writeShellApplication {
        name = "deploy";
        runtimeInputs = [ ];
        text = ''
          exec "bend-''${1:?usage: deploy TOOL [ARGS...]   (TOOL: ops)}" "''${@:2}"
        '';
      };
      ok = pkgs.runCommand "ok" { } ''
          cd ${src}
          exec ${self.x}/bin/x --report "$out"
        '';
      one = pkgs.writeShellApplication { name = "one"; text = ''exec foo "$@" | tee x''; };
      bad = pkgs.runCommand "bad" { } ''
          for x in a b; do echo $x; done
          grep -q y z
        '';
    };
}
